analysis_plan.arithmetic: exact decimal context (prec 120, Inexact and Rounded trapped)
analysis_plan.excursion: maximal run of positive route cash with all named states known
analysis_plan.falsifier: l2Book top of the probe coin vs reconstructed bbo state at its server time; two consecutive mismatches falsify the reconstruction

routes.forward: hold complete sets made at par by splitOutcome+negateOutcome (basis 1 per unit); sell every member YES that has a bid; immediate cash = sum(bids) - 1; closed (zero residual) only when every member including the fallback is sold; otherwise unsold members are residual claims valued 0 until observable settlement
routes.inverse_full: buy every member YES at its ask, fallback included, then mergeQuestion; closed cash = 1 - sum(asks); available only with every ask present

analysis_plan.scope: recorded-vector bounds only: displayed touch, not takerability, fills, fees, conversion granularity, collateral identity or units
analysis_plan.state: per coin, the latest bbo at or before t, applied in (server time, receipt) order with equal times applied together; unknown before the first bbo for that coin

decision_rules.candidate_recorded_vector: any forward or inverse_full run with positive exact cash lasting at least 1000 ms of server time, all named states known, meta_pre unchanged, every subscription acked once, no bbo anomaly, falsifier not falsified, starting before any target meta event; a candidate is a recorded-vector bound for a separately frozen timing, depth, fee and conversion review, never execution or profit; forward runs with unsold members remain open residual claims until every claim retires
decision_rules.inconclusive: otherwise; every run of any length is still listed
decision_rules.park_no_qualifying_excursion_in_window: no candidate and no reason: uncensored window_closed stop, both meta reads unchanged, acks once, no anomaly or target meta event, falsifier >=100 comparisons and not falsified, all named states known by the hint, server time within 10 s of close
decision_rules.park_scope: a negative bound for this one window and question only; it does not generalize to other matches

premises.P10_bbo_stream: bbo is pushed only when the touch changes on a block and no update is lost, so the last bbo per coin is the touch until the next; falsifier: default l2Book on one named coin
premises.P11_server_time: bbo/l2Book time is the block time, equal across coins changed in one block; violations can only shorten or split runs, which the 1000 ms gate guards
premises.P12_initial_state: a bbo arrives at subscription; otherwise the coin is unknown until its first change and coverage starts later
premises.P1_membership: both outcomeMeta reads reproduce the frozen canonical question structure and no target questionUpdated/questionSettled/member outcomeSettled arrives; tested
premises.P3_conversions: documented splitOutcome, negateOutcome and mergeQuestion at par in the books quote token, fallback included in mergeQuestion; amounts, granularity and fees unverified
premises.P4_merged_book: one YES book per member carries both sides (books-v1 mirrors consistent); not retested
premises.P9_collateral: all members labelled USDC; identity unresolved beyond the label; no USD claim

reads: meta_post after the websocket closes (any stop after meta_pre succeeded)
rest.transport: frozen books-v1 fetch_all: one request each, no retry, redirect or proxy

retention.cap_rule: stop reading once the bundle reaches cap - reserve; the pending records, stop event and meta_post then fit; a stop is a censored prefix
retention.every_frame: sent and received frames, connection events, both REST bodies
retention.members: gzip member every 10 s or 32768 raw bytes

subscriptions: bbo for each member YES coin #<10*outcome>, members ascending
l2Book {coin, no nSigFigs/mantissa/fast} for the lowest named member

window.launch: between open - 900 s and open - 120 s, else refused

storage_request_bytes.note: needs a separate root allocation; not drawn from the continuation grant; no compression ratio is assumed: a cap stop is a censored prefix

target_note: one question per frozen plan; 363 proposed (hint 2026-10-04T18:45Z; tightest books-v1 forward margin, -0.00017 at 13:16 UTC on 2 October); 359 (hint 2026-10-03T16:00Z) is the earlier alternate; root selects at freeze without a source change
